```python
class PyEvaluator:
    def __init__(self, layout):
        self.layout = layout
        self._columns = {}   # cell -> list of values length U
        self._eq_masks = {}  # (cell, position) -> int

    def column(self, cell):
        col = self._columns.get(cell)
        if col is None:
            dom = self.layout.domain_of_cell(cell)
            stride = self.layout.cell_strides[cell]
            size = self.layout.cell_sizes[cell]
            pattern = []
            for v in dom: pattern.extend([v]*stride)
            reps = self.layout.size // (stride*size)
            col = pattern * reps
            self._columns[cell] = col
        return col
```

Training masks:
```python
def train_masks(univ_masks, layout, train):
    U = layout.size; nbytes = (U+7)//8
    bytes_of = [m.to_bytes(nbytes,'little') for m in univ_masks]  # P × 8KB = 256KB ✓
    # map training windows to indices, dedupe preserving first occurrence
    first = {}; ordered = []; records = []
    for i, window in enumerate(train):
        u = layout.encode_window(window)
        if u not in first:
            first[u] = len(ordered); ordered.append(u); records.append(i)
    n = len(ordered)
    tnb = (n+7)//8
    masks = []
    for ba in bytes_of:
        out = bytearray(tnb)
        for bit, u in enumerate(ordered):
            if (ba[u>>3] >> (u&7)) & 1:
                out[bit>>3] |= 1 << (bit&7)
        masks.append(int.from_bytes(out,'little'))
    return masks, records
```
Cost: P × n bit tests = 32 × 10000 = 320k ✓ ~0.15s per job. Batch ≤ 640k ✓ fine.

```python
class PyDecoder:
    def __init__(self, layout, univ_masks, active):
        self.layout=layout
        full = (1<<layout.size)-1
        theory = full
        for clause in active:
            cover=0
            for pid in clause: cover |= univ_masks[pid]
            theory &= cover
        self.theory=theory
        self._eq={}   # (cell,pos)->mask
        self._allowed={}  # fixed_key -> list of indices
        self._stats={}  # (fixed_key, cell) -> (counts list, minidx list)
    def eq_mask(self, cell, pos): cached layout.cell_equal_mask(cell,pos)
    def allowed(self, fixed_key):
        mask = self.theory
        for cell,pos in fixed_key: mask &= self.eq_mask(cell,pos)
        indices = list(iter_set_bits(mask, nbytes))
        cache it
    def stats(self, fixed_key, cell):
        counts=[0]*D; minidx=[SENT]*D
        stride = layout.cell_strides[cell]; size=layout.cell_sizes[cell]
        for u in indices:
            p = (u // stride) % size
            counts[p]+=1
            if u < minidx[p]: minidx[p]=u
        return counts, minidx
```
Note: indices are ascending, so minidx[p] is set on first occurrence; the `if u < minidx[p]` check handles it ✓.

Then answer(): intervals from spellings; count = Σ sum(counts[lo:hi]); witness = min(minidx[lo:hi]) with sentinel.

Cost per query: stats O(#allowed) (cached per (fixed,cell)), interval sums O(D) in C-level sum() ✓.

Memory: counts/minidx lists of length D ≤ 65536 → 2 × 512KB per cache entry; cap cache size.
